apps.name: MuffinEMU
apps.subtitle: Wii U, the way it should be.
apps.localizedDescription:
Wii U on iPhone and iPad. Play on-screen, use the GamePad, or switch to your TV. Free, open source, and built around Cemu.

Games, keys and system files are not included. Bring the games you own.

- Add games from Files: WUA, WUD/WUX, decrypted or encrypted with your own keys. Updates and DLC install in the app
- HD box art and game info find themselves: summaries, release dates and more
- Download art packs, including 3D boxes, or add your own covers in up to 4K
- Cards, large covers, 3D boxes, grid or list, any size, with sorting, grouping and renaming

[Serious Graphics]
- A Metal renderer built for Apple GPUs, with Vulkan as an option
- Graphic packs, resolution scaling and a brightness boost for dim scenes
- Bring your desktop Cemu shader caches and skip the stutter

[Speed]
- Plays out of the box
- Turn on JIT with StikDebug or LiveContainer for the full-speed recompiler. MuffinEMU offers to do it at launch

[The GamePad, Done Right]
- On-screen controls measured from a real Wii U GamePad, with skins, analog sticks and a layout editor
- Controllers work right alongside it
- One screen or both, iPhone portrait, or the TV picture on an external display

[Online]
- Pretendo Network with your own Wii U account files
- Custom servers, including ones you host at home

[Make It Yours]
- Per-game settings, Basic and Advanced modes, and one-tap settings backup
- 31 app icons with matching themes

Free, open source and updated constantly. Wii U on iOS, the way it should be.

Official Site: https://muffinemu.github.io/MuffinEMU/
Guides: https://muffinemu.github.io/MuffinEMU/docs/
Source code: https://github.com/MuffinEMU/Muffin-EMU
Report a problem: https://github.com/MuffinEMU/Muffin-EMU/issues

Legal

MuffinEMU is not affiliated with Nintendo or Apple. Wii U is a trademark of Nintendo. No copyrighted games, keys or firmware are distributed here.

versions.localizedDescription:
- Fixed the picture hitching when the device sits right at the heat limit.
- Leaving the app is lighter on the main thread.
- The buttons in the top bar keep working after repeated use.
- Metal: re-encode GPU-compressed BC textures up to 1024x1024 on GPUs without BC
- Update known issues section in README
- Add MuffinEMU Game Compatibility documentation
- Rename COMPATABILITY.md to COMPATIBILITY.md
- Add compatible games section to README
- New "Two cores (Experimental)" CPU option: faster than one core, with less heat and fewer performance cores than three.
- Touch input and the top bar buttons keep working after repeated use and after swapping screens in the HOME menu.
- Add pause-hidden-screen and hide-controls-in-home-menu settings
- The on-screen sticks follow your thumb a little past their ring, so long play is more comfortable.
- Metal: keep compiled pipelines in our own binary archive and build only the shaders pipelines need
- Gate CPU core modes by device capability
- Add Load from Folder and Load from File to the library
- Restyle project Markdown docs and fix COMPATIBILITY.md
- Fix storage check access levels
- Point at the game folder when a code, content or meta folder is chosen
- Metal: save compiled pipelines when the app leaves the foreground and when a title shuts down
- Metal: re-encode raw blocks into cube maps and cube arrays on GPUs without BC

privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: MuffinEMU uses the microphone only when a Wii U game asks for GamePad microphone input.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: MuffinEMU connects to game servers on your local network when you use a custom server hosted at home.
